verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.191
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 5.191

verses.pali: 20. Brāhmaṇavagga
verses.english: 20. Brahmins

verses.pali: Soṇasutta
verses.english: Hounds

verses.pali: “Pañcime, bhikkhave, porāṇā brāhmaṇadhammā etarahi sunakhesu sandissanti, no brāhmaṇesu.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these five ancient traditions of the brahmins are exhibited these days among hounds, but not among brahmins.

verses.pali: Katame pañca?
verses.english: What five?

verses.pali: Pubbe sudaṁ, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇiṁyeva gacchanti, no abrāhmaṇiṁ.
verses.english: In the past brahmins had sex only with brahmin women, not with others.

verses.pali: Etarahi, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇimpi gacchanti, abrāhmaṇimpi gacchanti.
verses.english: These days brahmins have sex with both brahmin women and others.

verses.pali: Etarahi, bhikkhave, sunakhā sunakhiṁyeva gacchanti, no asunakhiṁ.
verses.english: But these days hounds have sex only with female hounds, not with other species.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo porāṇo brāhmaṇadhammo etarahi sunakhesu sandissati, no brāhmaṇesu.
verses.english: This is the first ancient tradition of the brahmins exhibited these days among hounds, but not among brahmins.

verses.pali: Pubbe sudaṁ, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇiṁ utuniṁyeva gacchanti, no anutuniṁ.
verses.english: In the past brahmins had sex only with brahmin women in the fertile phase of the menstrual cycle, not at other times.

verses.pali: Etarahi, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇiṁ utunimpi gacchanti, anutunimpi gacchanti.
verses.english: These days brahmins have sex with brahmin women both in the fertile phase of the menstrual cycle and at other times.

verses.pali: Etarahi, bhikkhave, sunakhā sunakhiṁ utuniṁyeva gacchanti, no anutuniṁ.
verses.english: But these days hounds have sex only with female hounds when they are in heat, not at other times.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, dutiyo porāṇo brāhmaṇadhammo etarahi sunakhesu sandissati, no brāhmaṇesu.
verses.english: This is the second ancient tradition of the brahmins exhibited these days among hounds, but not among brahmins.

verses.pali: Pubbe sudaṁ, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇiṁ neva kiṇanti no vikkiṇanti, sampiyeneva saṁvāsaṁ sambandhāya sampavattenti.
verses.english: In the past brahmins neither bought nor sold brahmin women. They lived together because they loved each other and wanted their family line to continue.

verses.pali: Etarahi, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇiṁ kiṇantipi vikkiṇantipi, sampiyenapi saṁvāsaṁ sambandhāya sampavattenti.
verses.english: These days brahmins both buy and sell brahmin women. They live together whether they love each other or not and they want their family line to continue.

verses.pali: Etarahi, bhikkhave, sunakhā sunakhiṁ neva kiṇanti no vikkiṇanti, sampiyeneva saṁvāsaṁ sambandhāya sampavattenti.
verses.english: But these days hounds neither buy nor sell female hounds. They live together because they’re attracted to each other and want their family line to continue.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, tatiyo porāṇo brāhmaṇadhammo etarahi sunakhesu sandissati, no brāhmaṇesu.
verses.english: This is the third ancient tradition of the brahmins exhibited these days among hounds, but not among brahmins.

verses.pali: Pubbe sudaṁ, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇā na sannidhiṁ karonti dhanassapi dhaññassapi rajatassapi jātarūpassapi.
verses.english: In the past brahmins did not store up money, grain, silver, or gold.

verses.pali: Etarahi, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇā sannidhiṁ karonti dhanassapi dhaññassapi rajatassapi jātarūpassapi.
verses.english: These days brahmins do store up money, grain, silver, and gold.

verses.pali: Etarahi, bhikkhave, sunakhā na sannidhiṁ karonti dhanassapi dhaññassapi rajatassapi jātarūpassapi.
verses.english: But these days hounds don’t store up money, grain, silver, or gold.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, catuttho porāṇo brāhmaṇadhammo etarahi sunakhesu sandissati, no brāhmaṇesu.
verses.english: This is the fourth ancient tradition of the brahmins exhibited these days among hounds, but not among brahmins.

verses.pali: Pubbe sudaṁ, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇā sāyaṁ sāyamāsāya pāto pātarāsāya bhikkhaṁ pariyesanti.
verses.english: In the past brahmins went looking for almsfood for dinner at dusk, and for breakfast at daybreak.

verses.pali: Etarahi, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇā yāvadatthaṁ udarāvadehakaṁ bhuñjitvā avasesaṁ ādāya pakkamanti.
verses.english: These days brahmins eat as much as they like until their bellies are full, then take away the leftovers.

verses.pali: Etarahi, bhikkhave, sunakhā sāyaṁ sāyamāsāya pāto pātarāsāya bhikkhaṁ pariyesanti.
verses.english: But these days hounds go looking for dinner at dusk, and for breakfast at daybreak.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, pañcamo porāṇo brāhmaṇadhammo etarahi sunakhesu sandissati, no brāhmaṇesu.
verses.english: This is the fifth ancient tradition of the brahmins exhibited these days among hounds, but not among brahmins.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca porāṇā brāhmaṇadhammā etarahi sunakhesu sandissanti, no brāhmaṇesū”ti.
verses.english: These five ancient traditions of the brahmins are exhibited these days among hounds, but not among brahmins.”

verses.pali: Paṭhamaṁ.
